test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**frightened**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context involves a boy repeatedly crying "Wolf!" falsely and being warned to save his cry for genuine danger.
 
• The appropriate adjective describes the seriousness and urgency for a true emergency.
 
• "**Frightened**" (डरे हुए) aligns with the genuine feeling of fear that should accompany a real wolf sighting.
